review_notes: The file has only two definitions, angularSourceFunction and angularCorrectionFunction. Both are problem-specific formulas. They combine the project's spanSolve, realCorrector and PeriodicPrimitive.primitive with a mean-subtracted inner product. I found no Mathlib, Batteries or core concept that either one competes with. The helper concepts they use (spanSolve, realCorrector, PeriodicPrimitive.primitive, Period := UnitAddCircle) are defined in other project files. Period reuses Mathlib's UnitAddCircle. I did not look for Mathlib analogues of those helpers, because they are outside the target file. Any duplication would be a matter for the files that define them.
